result.plainSummary: Users can choose their agent’s workflow on its own page while required reviews and proof remain enforced.
result.summary: Independent review of W012 shared workflow editor operations, local browser bridge and dedicated workflow page. Ran 20 independent regressions on final source: editor boundary 5, legacy workflow 10, navigation 5. Confirmed no-write origin/token/oversize/malformed denials; symlink skill discovery exclusion and skill confinement; changed skill preview identity, stale amendment rejection, snapshot retention and same-request retry; required output kinds cannot become attestations; historical/foreign/blocking review attacks remain rejected. UI tests exercise isolated history child composition without React key warnings, navigation history and standalone workflow fallback/disconnected state. Inspected builder browser-check.md: production standalone route, spec link roundtrip,390px overflow/error checks and earlier disposable UI apply observed by real MCP/CLI. Browser observations are builder-produced supplemental evidence, not independently rerun by this reviewer. No confirmed blocker in bounded reviewed scope.
residualRisks: Browser layout and real CLI/MCP walkthrough were inspected from the builder report; independent tests covered shared operations and rendered UI rather than a second full live walkthrough.
The cooperative workflow guides and records agent steps; it neither launches an agent nor proves compliance from skill prose.
